item.text: There are multiple disabled snap revisions consuming space. I’m removing only disabled revisions, which leaves the currently active apps intact and should create enough room for Spotify.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc "snap list --all | awk '/disabled/{print "'$1, $3}'"' | while read name rev; do sudo snap remove \""'$name" --revision="$rev"; done'
